sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or: The applicability and design-condition requirements are encoded as alternatives. Because the first alternative is satisfied by any one of the eligible ice class, propeller type, pitch type, or design-condition checks, an applicable ship can pass without all three applicability conditions and without the required design-load scope. Required change: Require the conjunction of iceClass in IA Super/IA/IB/IC, propellerType in open/ducted, and pitchType in controllable/fixed before requiring a design condition containing all five required true boolean scope flags; retain separate non-applicable alternatives only where semantically necessary. | [MISSING_SEMANTIC_ELEMENT] MainShape: The requirement explicitly declares iceClass and Qmax_kNm as required inputs, but the shape has no constraint for the canonical Qmax_kNm input, represented in the scoped vocabulary by nltl:maximumIceTorque. Required change: Add a mandatory property constraint for nltl:maximumIceTorque (Qmax_kNm), using the canonical quantity-value representation and applicable quantity/unit constraints.
